items.q: After the first relapse the cohort splits into no-further-relapse, infrequent relapse and FRNS in the proportions:
items.exp: 25% no further relapse; 25% infrequent relapse; 50% FRNS. (Book p760)

items.q: Infrequent relapse is treated with steroid, tapered over 4 weeks:
items.exp: Infrequent relapse → steroid → taper over 4 wks during remission. (Book p760)

items.q: Frequently relapsing nephrotic syndrome (FRNS) is defined by:
opts: ≥ 2 relapses within 6 months or ≥ 4 relapses within 1 year
≥ 2 relapses within 1 year or ≥ 4 within 2 years
items.exp: FRNS: ≥ 2 relapse within 6 months; ≥ 4 relapse within 1 year. (Book p760)

items.q: The steroid-sparing regimen written for FRNS (to prevent steroid toxicity) is oral cyclophosphamide 2 mg/kg/day × 12 weeks plus steroid × 2 weeks, or:
items.exp: Steroid sparing drug: oral cyclophosphamide 2 mg/kg/day × 12 wks + steroid × 2 wks; oral levamisole. (Book p760)

items.q: The second relapse line defines relapse as proteinuria reappearing after:
items.exp: Relapse: proteinuria reappears after 1 month of intermission. (Book p760)

items.q: Steroid dependent nephrotic syndrome (SDNS) needs ≥ 2 consecutive relapses during tapering of steroid or within how many days after stopping steroid?
items.exp: SDNS: ≥ 2 consecutive relapses during tapering of steroid (or) within 14 days after stopping steroid. (Book p760)

items.q: The treatment written for SDNS is MMF 1200 mg/m²/day plus:
items.exp: Treatment: MMF 1200 mg/m²/day; rituximab 375 mg/m²/day × 4 doses. (Book p760)
